final_wiki.answer-Q-1222:
Q-1222: What is the largest prime number less than 679?
Answer: 673
Verification: 673 is prime (not divisible by 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23 — sqrt(673)≈25.9). 679=7×97 (composite). 678,677,676 all composite. So 673 is the largest prime < 679.
